header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner; nor intimation received.
body: This Petition was filed in year 2023 and was lastly fixed in court on 28-02-2024. Thereafter, no effort was made by the petitioner to proceed with the instant Petition and is pending without any progress. The conduct of the petitioner and her counsel shows that they have lost interest to pursue instant petition, therefore, same stands dismissed for nonprosecution.
